statement: Let 0 < σ < 1 and κ > 0. There is a constant c∗ = c∗(σ, κ) > 0 with the following property. For n, d, Ω, K as above, suppose U ∈ H1 0 (Ω; Rn×d) satisfies Z Ω UUT dx = In. For every η > 0 there exist a real lower triangular matrix C ∈ Rn×n and a path B ∈ C1(Ω; Symn) such that B(x−) = K, B(x+) = −K, sup x∈Ω ∥B(x)∥op ≤ κ, 5 and, for A = CU, EK(A) ≥ bσ n X i=1 ℓ2γ i + Z Ω  ∥A′ − BA∥2 HS + c∗ΦK(A, B)  dx − η.
